description.en-US: The letters printed in the appendix of The Praise of Glory (Stanbrook, 1914): to a friend, to Canon A., to Madame ***, to one who wished to become a Carmelite, and fragments. A selection; the groups differ in places from the French appendix.
description.pt-BR: As cartas do apêndice de The Praise of Glory (Stanbrook, 1914): a uma amiga, ao cônego A., à Senhora ***, a quem desejava ser carmelita e fragmentos. Uma seleção.
